decisions.status: proposed, and built against the freeze on new surface: [D101](D101-the-first-real-integration-is-nextclouds-approval-app-and-new-surface-waits-for-it.md) (the first real integration) item 4 allows no new owned domain, administration page or rail destination until its loop works, and this record is all three. It was begun on a branch cut before that freeze reached `main`, continued in the same working session after the freeze was pointed out, and brought into `main` on 2026-11-11 on that session's instruction, with the question whether it may pass the freeze asked and not answered by the product owner.
